description: This file defines the SearchResults class, which manages search result data, including hits, scores, options, and related display formatting functions within the SuiteCRM system. It handles retrieval of beans, formatting for display, and link generation for search results.

classes.name: SearchResults
classes.description: Class that encapsulates search result data, including hits, scoring, options, and display formatting methods within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SearchResults object with hits, grouping flag, search time, total hits, scores, and options.

methods.name: getHits
methods.description: Returns the array of search hits.

methods.name: getHitsAsBeans
methods.description: Retrieves search hits as loaded SugarBean objects, with formatting and link updates.

methods.name: formatForDisplay
methods.description: Formats a SugarBean's fields for display, handling enums, multienums, and currency formatting.

methods.name: updateFieldDefLinks
methods.description: Updates related links in a SugarBean based on field definitions.

methods.name: updateObjLinks
methods.description: Updates link fields in a SugarBean to generate proper URLs.

methods.name: getRelatedId
methods.description: Resolves related record IDs for linked beans.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML anchor tag linking to a specific record detail view.

methods.name: getScores
methods.description: Returns the array of scores for the search hits.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total number of search hits.

methods.name: getModuleTotal
methods.description: Returns total hits for a specific module.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns a specific search option by key.

methods.name: getSearchTime
methods.description: Returns the time taken to perform the search.

methods.name: isGroupedByModule
methods.description: Indicates whether hits are grouped by module.

methods.name: getLargestHitsCount
methods.description: Returns the largest number of hits among all modules.
